plugins.name: onepassword
plugins.description: Reach 1Password secrets behind a Touch ID gate on every use, and keep secret values out of the model transcript.

plugins.name: linode
plugins.description: Work with Linode inside the project's tag boundary: resources are created with the project tag, and writes to another project's resources are refused.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Quy trình review bằng nhiều model Claude độc lập, tái hiện từng finding trước khi tin, biến input tấn công thành test. Kèm script chẩn đoán sub-agent im lặng hay treo.

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Run OpenAI's Codex CLI non-interactively as a second opinion, and report every finding it returns to the user verbatim before touching any code.

plugins.name: k8s-local
plugins.description: Run a project's whole stack on a local Kubernetes cluster: build straight into the cluster's image store, refuse any context whose name and API server address are not local, and keep the datastores throwaway.
